source_row.acip: CHA GNYIS PA'I GZHI NI LONGS SPYOD YIN TE, SEMS CAN GYI NANG GI REG BYA LA LONGS SPYOD PA LAS BYUNG BA DANG , DE LA BDAG TU BZUNG BA'I DBANG GIS BYUNG BA'I PHYIR,
source_row.wylie: cha gnyis pa'i gzhi ni longs spyod yin te, sems can gyi nang gi reg bya la longs spyod pa las byung ba dang , de la bdag tu bzung ba'i dbang gis byung ba'i phyir
source_row.english: The non-virtues of the second division have enjoyments as their object: they occur through enjoyment in the form of physical sensations within a living being, or by force of one's taking possession of certain enjoyments.

spans.rationale: Division noun identifies the second group of non-virtues.
Second is the exact glossary ordinal here; division has its own cha.
Object noun at the end of the recast first clause; not the later enjoyment objects. Master mined give it a name remains rejected.
First enjoyments compound is the general object category, not the final anaphoric certain enjoyments.
Copular predication is recast as have X as their object. The complete yin glossary attests have; as their remains outside this verb.
The sole living-being compound locates the physical sensations; exclude a.
Interior/local relational word is rendered within, exactly glossary-attested. Depth follows the Tibetan lexical noun, not English preposition form.

spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: in the form of physical sensations
spans.rationale: Whole tangible-object compound has exact glossary physical sensations. Do not assign reg or bya to an arbitrary English member.
Second, nominalized enjoyment compound owns the singular in the explanatory clause, not either plural enjoyments.
Causal/ablative relation from enjoyment is rendered through; complete glossary supports this particle use.
First arising predicate owns the sole English occur, shared by the two coordinated causal explanations.
Coordinator presents two alternative ways the non-virtues arise; exact glossary or is licensed by the local structure.
Whole appropriation compound has the exact glossary taking possession. Do not absorb agentive possessive one's or the object certain enjoyments.
Grasp/take member has exact glossary taking and is strictly within the appropriation parent; possession remains licensed by the whole compound.
Force is the exact lexical head of the causal expression; exclude by and of.
Whole instrumental supplies by in the second causal alternative.

omissions.tib: ni; te; bound genitives; gyi and gi around nang; first la after reg bya
omissions.reason: Topic and internal/possessive grammar is distributed across have X as their object, within, and in the form of. The narrow yin/have and nang/within attestations remain; no invented standalone form equivalent or absence claim.
Anaphoric target is expanded as certain enjoyments, echoing the earlier term. A pronoun/noun or whole de la phrase alignment would overstate an uncertain unique correspondence; preserve unwrapped.

Both causal alternatives share the one English occur. Bank it once at the first predicate and omit the repeated second predicate plus causal closure; this is shared/distributed scope, not a claim of absent causation.

omissions.tib: bdag tu inside bdag tu bzung ba
omissions.reason: The appropriation sense licenses possession in the whole attested compound, but bdag tu has no separate exact master record and an internal member is not established merely by the remaining English word.

omissions.english: The non-virtues of the; as their; they; in the form of; a; of one's; of certain enjoyments
omissions.reason: Supplied classification, agentive/possessive and explanatory framing remains outside the lexical spans.
